article.title: Israeli settlers target a Ramallah road, and the city’s future with it
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Israel is preparing to give settlers access to a main Palestinian thoroughfare in Ramallah, a move that would bring checkpoints and gates to one of the West Bank’s last spaces of free Palestinian movement and affordable urban growth.
